items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: I know Tuxedas, that was Papa Celestans.

ctx.x: Do you remember who were in some of those bands, like the Excelsior, who the leader was?

Well, I don't know who was the leader of the Excelsior, but I did remember some of the fellows that used to play Eno's band. I think Manuel Perez, he was a trumpet player. I know Tuxedas, that was Papa Celestans. And Ada Jackson. The trubor player. Yeah, the sousaphone player. And I just can't think of who I was in the band at the time, but I remember the band when I was quite a young fellow. Now then after late years, then come the Eureka brass band. Well, at that time, I had a fellow playing in that band by the…
I never knew him. What did he play?
